description: Interpret the current RGB directly first. Localize an observed plausible object candidate when decision-relevant identity or location needs assistance, or measure its distance when metric evidence is needed. Do not outsource general scene understanding or search for unseen targets by copying the task narrative. Returns candidates and annotated evidence; an empty detection does not prove absence and should prompt reconsideration of weak visual hypotheses. Detection confidence is not task identity. Distance is camera-to-visible-surface depth, not horizontal or target-center distance. not_requested means distance was not requested; inconsistent_depth_surfaces means a candidate was detected but its region is too depth-variable for a reliable scalar distance (including sloped or extended surfaces), not that the object is absent. Tool execution success does not imply valid distance; quantitative claims require an applicable valid measurement.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise object category and directly observed appearance, e.g. brown-walled building or beige flat roof. Do not add invented attributes, alternative identities, or task-relative relations such as directly below the UAV; interpret those relations separately.

include_distance.description: true estimates distances to detected candidates; false performs localization without distance estimation.
